question: What is the main focus of the passage?

options.text: The benefits and harms of single-use plastic
The environmental benefits of the sustainable utensils
The economic benefits of sustainable utensils

solution:
The correct answer is: **'The environmental benefits of the sustainable utensils'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main focus of the passage is: **'****The environmental benefits of the sustainable utensils'.**
 
• The given passage speaks about the sustainable utensils made from natural sources as these are not harmful to the environment and they do not have a negative consequences like plastic products which causes a negative impact to the environment resulting the loss of the world.

 Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'The importance of sustainable alternatives'** is not the main focus of the passage.
 
• **'The benefits and harms of single-use plastic'** is not the main focus of the passage.
 
• **'The economic benefits of sustainable utensils' **is not the main focus of the passage.
